text:
Shane Pinto has turned into Ottawa's timely scorer. Five of his six goals have come in the last ten games, including the tying goal against Buffalo on Nov. 4, when he cleaned up a Philip Tomasino rebound "with 8:27 to go in the third," as Joe Yerdon of Bleacher Report put it. His goals have added 1.28 wins in our win model, 34th in the league and ahead of the 0.96 those chances usually swing.

The underlying picture is steadier than spectacular. He's playing nearly 20 minutes a night, Ottawa is roughly even in expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on at five on five, and his finishing is only a little ahead of his chances. Evolving-Hockey's note from last season adds a caveat: he plays with strong teammates, which flatters raw numbers. Our projection's middle case is 27 more goals the rest of the way, after 23 all of last season. What we'd watch is whether the timely goals keep arriving as the minutes stay high.
headline: Ottawa's timely scorer
